Needs changes before merge.

### What looks good

- `crates/geometry/src/sketch_chains/sample.rs` and `crates/app/src/operation/contour_sketch.rs` keep `2D Contour` sketch curves analytic, so posted `G2` and `G3` arcs stay exact.
- `contour_sketch::validate_plan` refuses side compensation (`Inside` or `Outside`) and control or wear compensation (`G41`/`G42`) on open sketch chains by chain name.
- `crates/app/src/operation/stitch.rs` shifts `Toolpath::comps` indices by `base` when it appends multiple sketch chain passes.
- `PROJECT_VERSION` steps cleanly from `72` to `73` with additive `ChainOverrideDto` and `FeatureSelDto` fields and backward-compatible defaults.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/features.rs`, `crates/app/src/mcp/pick.rs`, and `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` align on `sketch_chain` and `sketch_layer` picks, and `Process change: yes` is in the PR body.
- Existing tests keep their assertions intact.

### Results on PR head `4fa788688`

Trial merge with `upstream/main` (`4a326c7d9`) stopped on two code conflicts, so local verification ran on PR head `4fa788688`:

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-geometry --lib`: `49 passed; 0 failed`
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-geometry` (`dxf`, `dxf_profile`, `sketch_chains`, `sketch_chains_nesting`, `sketch_chains_refusals`, `sketch_data`): `17 + 5 + 7 + 4 + 7 + 9 passed; 0 failed`
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --lib`: `379 passed; 0 failed; 1 ignored`
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app` (`contour_dxf_sketch`, `contour_dxf_sketch_verify`, `mcp_dxf`, `operations`, `project_roundtrip`, `sketch_profile`): `3 + 3 + 2 + 120 (+ 6 ignored) + 73 + 8 passed; 0 failed`
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app` (`commands_undo`, `contour_outside_hole`, `control_comp`, `heights_selection`, `model_link`, `pick`, `pick_agnostic`, `posting`, `stock_sim_document`, `stock_stamp`, `wear_comp`): `30 + 5 + 5 + 9 + 7 + 9 + 5 (+ 2 ignored) + 17 + 9 + 4 + 5 passed; 0 failed`
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib`: `1224 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored`
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui` (`boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `edge_loop_pick`, `egui_app`, `operations`, `shell`): `3 + 7 + 2 + 4 + 4 + 31 + 21 passed; 0 failed`
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: `0 failed` (`0` warnings)

### Mutations and goldens

This PR changes geometry, toolpath generation, and safety checks, so this is a safety-tier review. We re-ran two mutations from the PR locally:

- `crates/app/src/sketch_model.rs:178-180` (`generation_problem`): removed the `OpParams::Contour` admission arm -> `whole_plate_auto_nesting_cuts_outer_outside_holes_inside_and_preserves_g2_g3_arcs` failed (`RED`) -> restored -> passed (`GREEN`).
- `crates/app/src/operation/contour_sketch.rs:125-136` (`validate_plan`): bypassed `open_side_err` and `!item.closed && control_comp` -> `open_chain_safety_refuses_side_compensation_and_g41_by_name` failed (`RED`) -> restored -> passed (`GREEN`).

Goldens: no `.nc`, `.cl`, or UI snapshot PNG files changed. `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj` changed only `"version": 72` to `"version": 73`.

### Requested before merge

1. **Resolve the merge conflicts with `upstream/main` (`4a326c7d9`).**
   - `crates/app/src/commands/operation/geometry.rs:86-90`: pass `prev.setup.as_deref()` to `probe_from_picks`.
   - `crates/app/src/operation/probe_pick.rs:183-196`: keep `setup: Option<&str>` on `probe_seed` and pass `setup` to `PickCtx::of(world, &sel.entity, setup)` while matching `&sel.feature`.
2. **Add before and after UI screenshots to the PR body.**
   - This PR changes UI files (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs`, `mill2d_page.rs`, `fields.rs`, `params_page.rs`, `crates/ui/src/interact.rs`, `pick_highlight.rs`, `state.rs`), and the PR body has no screenshots.
   - Store screenshot files only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, never on the PR branch.
3. **Keep whole-sketch `SrcRef::Entity` selections in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_page.rs:228-247`.**
   - `models` collects only `model::model_entities(&state.world)`, which excludes DXF sketches (compare `camcraft_app::sketch::placed_in` at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs:123`).
   - When an operation has `src: SrcRef::Entity("<sketch>")` (`src_kind == 1`), `op_page.rs:236-245` misses the sketch name in `models`, resets `state.op_ui.src_kind = 0`, and clears `state.op_ui.src_name`.
   - That resets the `Source` combo to `"Stock"`, hides the `geo_page.rs:117` whole-entity label, and passes `SrcRef::Stock` at `params_page.rs:235` to `sketch_chain_overrides_ui`, which hides `Per-chain overrides`.
   - Include placed DXF sketches in the `Source` list and add a UI harness test that exercises whole-sketch display and per-chain overrides before any layer click.
4. **Move new per-frame sketch work behind input-keyed caches (`docs/decisions/2238-frame-cost-rule.md` and `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`).**
   - `crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs:88-96` (`contour_auto_side`): calls uncached `contour_sketch::auto_side` before `selection_memo::answer`, even though `crates/app/src/operation/selection_memo.rs:130-136` already tracks sketch reads. Handle `SrcRef::Entity` in `selection_memo::contour_auto_side_fresh` (lines `214-218`) and route `contour_auto_side` through the memo.
   - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/fields.rs:271` (`sketch_chain_overrides_ui`): calls `operation::sketch_chain_infos(world, src)` on every frame without an input-keyed cache or `frame_cost::span`.
   - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs:135-154` (`sketch_layer_picks`): calls `sk.data.layers()` and `sk.data.chains().by_layer(...)` per layer on every frame without an input-keyed cache or `frame_cost::span`.
   - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_page.rs:170` calls `unresolved_note` on every frame, which calls `contour_sketch_pick::sketch_z_range` (lines `65-71`) and samples every sketch chain at `0.1` mm. Cache this Z range by sketch input too.

### Notes (non-blocking)

- `crates/app/src/commands/operation/geometry.rs`: `SetOperationGeometry::new` leaves old `chain_overrides` entries on `OpParams::Contour` when chains are deselected in the UI, so re-picking a chain later restores its old override silently.
- `crates/app/src/sketch_model.rs:92` (`source_profiles`): `out.dedup()` only removes adjacent duplicate profile names when picks interleave multiple sketches.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/fields.rs:312`: every override row labels its checkbox `"Reverse"`, which collides in label queries when multiple chains appear.
- `crates/ui/src/points_pick.rs:85-89` and `crates/app/src/pick/points.rs:141-147`: DXF sketch picks return the `"is a face"` refusal message instead of naming a DXF sketch pick.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/features.rs` grew to `426` lines (above the `400`-line file limit in `AGENTS.md`).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
